properties.description: Each served tool's description carries at most one sentence of reflow2 CONVENTION — the fraction a capable agent reconstructs incorrectly or not at all, such as the distinction between answering a gap and acknowledging one, or that a check left at `planned` is not confirmation. It arrives with the call, so it cannot be skipped by an agent that never loads the skill. Deliberately bounded at a sentence per tool: descriptions are context paid for on every session, and `cap:tool-search` exists because the surface is already large. Does not reverse `dec:skills-served` — the served skill keeps the depth, the worked examples and the reasoning; the tool carries only the irreducible minimum. PLANNED.
properties.name: The tool carries what an agent would never guess
